boss:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent SPRITE SHEET for Neo Geo cartoon pixel art 2D fighting game. Exactly THREE full-body sprites in ONE horizontal row in THREE equal-width cells with generous transparent gaps and consistent foot baseline. Nothing outside those three characters. Same character and SAME scale in all three cells, all facing RIGHT.
Character: final ascended form LA VACCA SATURNITA MEGA BRAIN. White and chocolate brown cow face, curved golden horns, peach pink snout, angry glowing lavender eyes. Round banded golden Saturn body, thick tilted golden rings round its waist. A clearly visible exposed glowing violet brain floats in a golden crown socket above the cow's forehead. Cosmic armored forearms with fists, strong hoofed legs. Torn dark purple cape. Purple energy gathers close to the silhouette. Keep cow face and planet rings readable, not a shapeless smoke monster. Strong dark contours, crisp pixel clusters, SNK fighting-game character scale.
Cell1 left: idle fighting stance, fists ready.
Cell2 middle: punching attack with RIGHT arm extended toward the right, slightly lunging body, feet at SAME baseline and scale.
Cell3 right: damaged recoiling pose, head tipped back, arms drawn back, cracked ring, feet at SAME baseline and scale.
Every whole character fits inside its cell with space around horns, fists, and rings; no overlapping adjacent cells, no floating particles distant from body. Equal cells, exactly three poses. No text, labels, frames, UI or watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background.
